payload.title: Scaffold the Data Parade publication repo and CMS app shell
payload.description: Repo DataParade-io/DataParade-newsroom (private, Git Flow, develop and main). Standard app shell (infra/site.json, siteId dataparade, brand data-parade), Papyrus 5.12.0. CMS Amplify app d35q7zv4zad2we created by stack amplify-app-shell-dataparade-cms in papyrus-production. ACM certificate for dataparade.anth.us issued, validation CNAME in the anth.us zone. Private repo: Amplify auto-build deploys on merge to main (autoDeploy false once the Papyrus release with merge-to-main OIDC deploys is adopted).
